verdict.rationale: Phoenix's source is in a public GitHub repository (github.com/Arize-ai/phoenix), and the docs describe it as built by Arize AI and the open-source community and free to self-host with no feature limitations. That clearly delivers the core of reading the source openly. missing for 10: the specific license is never named or quoted (e.g. Apache/ELv2 terms), and there is no independent confirmation of the license's openness or of any restrictions.
